bullets.text: rain on the water since first light. the sea swallows every drop and doesn't rise a hair.
duck reached shoryu-ji by the coast. rain falling into the sea, each drop gone exactly where it lands. 🌧️
wrung the socks out on a temple step. wet again before the next torii. stopped minding a while back.
rain-tired in the good way. the body goes quiet and just keeps walking.
can't catch the moment a raindrop becomes the sea. blink and it was always the sea.
